facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The boy saw a rabbit. It looked familiar. Love starts everything. Real comes from love.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: One day, the boy saw a brown rabbit in the garden. The rabbit looked just like his old velveteen toy. Real comes from love, and the boy felt it in his heart. The rabbit paused and looked at the boy with warm eyes. A smile spread across the boy's face. He knew that his love had made something truly magical.
facts.Word cards: became = 됐다 / real = 진짜의 / amazing = 놀라운 / spring = 봄
